## Business Requirements

#### Account Balance and Transaction Processing

- **REQ-F-001** — [Event-driven] When the daily transaction posting job executes, the system shall read each transaction record sequentially from the daily transactions file and, for each record, perform validation before determining whether to post or reject the transaction. [source: REQ-F-001 -> rule `fa45901e_05f…` -> `CBTRN02C`] `requirements-derived`
- **REQ-F-002** — [Event-driven] When a transaction record is read from the daily transactions file and end-of-file is not yet reached, the system shall set the result to success (0); when end-of-file is encountered, the system shall set the result to 16 and terminate the processing loop; when any other read error occurs, the system shall set the result to 12. [source: REQ-F-002 -> rule `10c693fe_b78…` -> `CBTRN02C`] `requirements-derived`
- **REQ-F-003** — [Event-driven] When a transaction record requires validation, the system shall look up the card number in the cross reference file; if the card number is not found, the system shall set the validation failure reason to 100. [source: REQ-F-003 -> rule `e136489a_095…` -> `CBTRN02C`] `requirements-derived`
- **REQ-F-004** — [Event-driven] When the card number is found in the cross reference file, the system shall retrieve the associated account ID and look up the account record in the account data file; if the account record is not found, the system shall set the validation failure reason to 101. [source: REQ-F-004 -> rule `e136489a_095…` -> `CBTRN02C`] `requirements-derived`
- **REQ-F-005** — [Event-driven] When the account record is found, the system shall compute a temporary balance as current cycle credit minus current cycle debit plus the transaction amount; if the credit limit is less than the temporary balance, the system shall set the validation failure reason to 102. [source: REQ-F-005 -> rule `e136489a_095…` -> `CBTRN02C`] `requirements-derived`
- **REQ-F-006** — [Event-driven] When the account record is found and the credit limit check passes, the system shall compare the account expiration date against the first 10 characters (date portion) of the transaction's original timestamp; if the expiration date is earlier than the transaction date, the system shall set the validation failure reason to 103. [source: REQ-F-006 -> rule `e136489a_095…` -> `CBTRN02C`] `requirements-derived`
- **REQ-F-007** — [Event-driven] When all validation checks pass, the system shall set the validation failure reason to 0. [source: REQ-F-007 -> rule `e136489a_095…` -> `CBTRN02C`] `requirements-derived`
- **REQ-F-008** — [Event-driven] When a transaction fails validation, the system shall assemble a rejection record containing the original transaction data and the validation failure reason code and description, then write the rejection record to the daily rejection output file (daily rejection file, `DALYREJS-FILE`). [source: REQ-F-008 -> rule `1f60ea05_ac0…` -> `CBTRN02C`] `requirements-derived`
- **REQ-F-009** — [Event-driven] When a transaction passes all validation checks, the system shall add the transaction amount to the current account balance in the account data file. [source: REQ-F-009 -> rule `13910ebc_0a3…` -> `CBTRN02C`] `requirements-derived`
- **REQ-F-010** — [Event-driven] When posting a valid transaction, if the transaction amount is greater than or equal to zero, the system shall add the transaction amount to the current cycle credit total on the account record. [source: REQ-F-010 -> rule `13910ebc_0a3…` -> `CBTRN02C`] `requirements-derived`
- … 276 further requirements in `.atx/mfre/specs/AccountBalanceandTransactionProcessing/spec/AccountBalanceandTransactionProcessing/requirements.md`

#### Credit Card Record Management

- **REQ-F-001** — [Event-driven] When the user submits a menu option, the system shall right-align the entered option, replace any embedded spaces with zeros, and convert the result to a two-digit numeric value before validation. [source: REQ-F-001 -> rule `14d9760e_3e0…` -> `COMEN01C`] `requirements-derived`
- **REQ-F-002** — [Unwanted] If the entered menu option is not numeric, is zero, or exceeds the number of available menu options, the system shall flag the selection as invalid. [source: REQ-F-002 -> rule `0993194d_474…` -> `COMEN01C`] `requirements-derived`
- **REQ-F-003** — [Unwanted] If a regular user selects a menu option restricted to administrators, the system shall reject the selection by flagging it as invalid. [source: REQ-F-003 -> rule `ffa4f846_e1e…` -> `COMEN01C`] `requirements-derived`
- **REQ-F-004** — [Event-driven] When the selected menu option's target is the paused sentinel, the system shall route to the paused-option handler instead of transferring control to the option's program. [source: REQ-F-004 -> rule `150cd397_b47…` -> `COMEN01C`] `requirements-derived`
- **REQ-F-005** — [Event-driven] When the selected menu option's target program name begins with the placeholder prefix `'DUMMY'`, the system shall route to the not-yet-implemented handler instead of transferring control to the option's program. [source: REQ-F-005 -> rule `8b62b461_a55…` -> `COMEN01C`] `requirements-derived`
- **REQ-F-006** — [Event-driven] When the selected option is valid, authorized, and targets an active program, the system shall record the originating transaction identifier (`'CM00'`) and originating program identifier (`'COMEN01C'`) into the session context, reset the program context to zero, and transfer control to the target program with the session context. [source: REQ-F-006 -> rule `253c6485_2b2…` -> `COMEN01C`] `requirements-derived`
- **REQ-F-007** — [Event-driven] When the menu is presented to a returning user with existing session context, the system shall read the user's screen input and route processing based on the attention key: if the Enter key is pressed, proceed to option processing; if PF3 is pressed, navigate back; otherwise invoke the default handler. [source: REQ-F-007 -> rule `da3f03b9_1a6…` -> `COMEN01C`] `requirements-derived`
- **REQ-F-008** — [Event-driven] When the user submits a menu option, the system shall right-align the entered option, replace any embedded spaces with zeros, and convert the result to a two-digit numeric value before validation. [source: REQ-F-008 -> rule `14d9760e_3e0…` -> `COMEN01C`] `requirements-derived`
- **REQ-F-009** — [Unwanted] If the entered option is not numeric, equals zero, or exceeds the number of available menu options (currently 11), the system shall flag the selection as invalid. [source: REQ-F-009 -> rule `0993194d_474…` -> `COMEN01C`] `requirements-derived`
- **REQ-F-010** — [Unwanted] If the authenticated user is a regular user and the selected menu option is restricted to administrators, the system shall reject the selection and flag it as invalid. [source: REQ-F-010 -> rule `ffa4f846_e1e…` -> `COMEN01C`] `requirements-derived`

#### Customer and Account Data Export and Import

- **REQ-F-001** — [Ubiquitous] The system shall capture the current calendar date and clock time at the start of the export run and format them into a single 26-character run timestamp of the form `YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS.00`, where the date components are separated by hyphens, the time components are separated by colons, a single space separates the date and time portions, and the fixed suffix `.00` is appended; this timestamp shall be shared by every record written during the run. [source: REQ-F-001 -> rule `d3f3d92f_d9c…` -> `CBEXPORT`] `requirements-derived`
- **REQ-F-002** — [Ubiquitous] The system shall open the customer input data store, account input data store, cross-reference input data store, transaction input data store, and card input data store for reading, and the export output data store for writing, before any records are exported. [source: REQ-F-002 -> rule `cb7ed185_1de…` -> `CBEXPORT`] `requirements-derived`
- **REQ-F-003** — [Ubiquitous] The system shall export records from the five source stores in the following fixed order: customers, accounts, card cross-references, transactions, and cards, using the shared run timestamp and a single shared sequence counter across all five export phases. [source: REQ-F-003 -> rule `d2d264cb_57d…` -> `CBEXPORT`] `requirements-derived`
- **REQ-F-004** — [State-driven] While records remain in the customer input data store, the system shall read each customer record sequentially and emit one customer export record per customer until the end of the customer input data store is reached. [source: REQ-F-004 -> rule `31d00214_51a…` -> `CBEXPORT`] `requirements-derived`
- **REQ-F-005** — [Event-driven] When a customer record has been read from the customer input data store, the system shall assemble an export record with record type `'C'`, the shared run timestamp, the next sequence number, originating branch `'0001'`, region `'NORTH'`, and the customer's identity fields, name components, three address lines, state, country, ZIP, two phone numbers, SSN, government-issued identifier, date of birth, EFT account number, primary-cardholder indicator, and FICO credit score, then write the assembled record to the export output data store. [source: REQ-F-005 -> rule `15419c93_6ca…` -> `CBEXPORT`] `requirements-derived`
- **REQ-F-006** — [State-driven] While records remain in the account input data store, the system shall read each account record sequentially and emit one account export record per account until the end of the account input data store is reached. [source: REQ-F-006 -> rule `59984bee_c59…` -> `CBEXPORT`] `requirements-derived`
- **REQ-F-007** — [Event-driven] When an account record has been read from the account input data store, the system shall assemble an export record with record type `'A'`, the shared run timestamp, the next sequence number, originating branch `'0001'`, region `'NORTH'`, and the account's identifier, active status, current balance, credit limit, cash credit limit, open date, expiration date, reissue date, current-cycle credit and debit totals, address ZIP, and group identifier, then write the assembled record to the export output data store. [source: REQ-F-007 -> rule `3273b1cc_c85…` -> `CBEXPORT`] `requirements-derived`
- **REQ-F-008** — [State-driven] While records remain in the cross-reference input data store, the system shall read each card cross-reference entry sequentially and emit one cross-reference export record per entry until the end of the cross-reference input data store is reached. [source: REQ-F-008 -> rule `bef0ffed_365…` -> `CBEXPORT`] `requirements-derived`
- **REQ-F-009** — [Event-driven] When a card cross-reference entry has been read from the cross-reference input data store, the system shall assemble an export record with record type `'X'`, the shared run timestamp, the next sequence number, originating branch `'0001'`, region `'NORTH'`, and the card number with its associated customer identifier and account identifier, then write the assembled record to the export output data store. [source: REQ-F-009 -> rule `07decb90_039…` -> `CBEXPORT`] `requirements-derived`
- **REQ-F-010** — [State-driven] While records remain in the transaction input data store, the system shall read each transaction record sequentially and emit one transaction export record per transaction until the end of the transaction input data store is reached. [source: REQ-F-010 -> rule `b96fc8d6_e00…` -> `CBEXPORT`] `requirements-derived`

#### Payment Authorization Processing and Fraud Review

- **REQ-F-001** — [Ubiquitous] The system shall derive the authorization year, month, and day from the caller-supplied origination date by treating positions 1–2 as the year, positions 3–4 as the month, and positions 5–6 as the day. [source: REQ-F-001 -> rule `c84d91da_f4c…` -> `COPAUS2C`] `requirements-derived`
- **REQ-F-002** — [Ubiquitous] The system shall compute the authorization time by subtracting the caller-supplied packed authorization time from `999999999` and shall split the resulting nine-digit value into hour (positions 1–2), minute (positions 3–4), second (positions 5–6), and millisecond (positions 7–9) components. [source: REQ-F-002 -> rule `73569e64_360…` -> `COPAUS2C`] `requirements-derived`
- **REQ-F-003** — [Ubiquitous] The system shall insert one row into the fraud authorization store (`CARDDEMO.AUTHFRDS`) carrying the card, authorization, merchant, amounts, response, match status, fraud action, account, and customer details, the reconstructed authorization timestamp formatted with `'YY-MM-DD HH24.MI.SSNNNNNN'`, and the current system date as the fraud report date. [source: REQ-F-003 -> rule `1031538f_e5c…` -> `COPAUS2C`] `requirements-derived`
- **REQ-F-004** — [Event-driven] When the insert against the fraud authorizations store reports a duplicate-key outcome (SQLCODE = -803), the system shall invoke the fraud update step to update the existing fraud authorization row with the fraud action code and current report date. [source: REQ-F-004 -> rule `df80805a_810…` -> `COPAUS2C`] `requirements-derived`
- **REQ-F-005** — [Ubiquitous] The system shall reconstruct the authorization timestamp key for an update by inverting the packed authorization time from `999999999`, splitting the origination date into year, month, and day components, splitting the recovered time into hour, minute, second, and millisecond components, and staging the card number, assembled timestamp, and fraud action code for the update operation. [source: REQ-F-005 -> rule `4a8b0f51_8fd…` -> `COPAUS2C`] `requirements-derived`
- **REQ-F-006** — [Event-driven] When updating an existing row in the fraud authorizations store (`CARDDEMO.AUTHFRDS`), the system shall set the fraud action code (`AUTH_FRAUD`) and the fraud report date (`FRAUD_RPT_DATE`) to the current date for the row identified by card number (`CARD_NUM`) and authorization timestamp (`AUTH_TS`). [source: REQ-F-006 -> rule `fc6bf142_013…` -> `COPAUS2C`] `requirements-derived`
- **REQ-F-007** — [Event-driven] When the fraud analyst confirms the fraud review action on the pending-authorization view, the system shall restore the session context and route the request to the fraud-marking flow. [source: REQ-F-007 -> rule `0e96be02_d87…` -> `COPAUS1C`] `requirements-derived`
- **REQ-F-008** — [Event-driven] When the fraud-marking flow is triggered for a selected pending authorization, the system shall read the authorization summary keyed by the account identifier from the authorization store; if the summary is not found or the authorization store is exhausted, the system shall set the end-of-authorizations flag. [source: REQ-F-008 -> rule `39178f9d_ee5…` -> `COPAUS1C`] `requirements-derived`
- **REQ-F-009** — [Event-driven] When the authorization summary is found, the system shall read the matching authorization detail segment keyed by the selected authorization key from the authorization store. [source: REQ-F-009 -> rule `39178f9d_ee5…` -> `COPAUS1C`] `requirements-derived`
- **REQ-F-010** — [Event-driven] When the authorization detail has been retrieved, the system shall invert the fraud indicator: if the current fraud indicator is confirmed fraud (`'F'`), the system shall set both the record's fraud indicator and the requested action to remove-fraud (`'R'`); otherwise, the system shall set both the record's fraud indicator and the requested action to confirm-fraud (`'F'`). [source: REQ-F-010 -> rule `939fc333_fcd…` -> `COPAUS1C`] `requirements-derived`
- … 43 further requirements in `.atx/mfre/specs/PaymentAuthorizationProcessingandFraudReview/spec/PaymentAuthorizationProcessingandFraudReview/requirements.md`

#### Transaction Type Reference Data Maintenance

- **REQ-F-001** — [Ubiquitous] The system shall open the transaction record data store for sequential reading before any maintenance records are processed. [source: REQ-F-001 -> rule `abe2cb2c_921…` -> `COBTUPDT`] `requirements-derived`
- **REQ-F-002** — [State-driven] While maintenance records remain to be processed, the system shall classify each record by its operation indicator, apply the corresponding action, and advance to the next record until the input feed is exhausted. [source: REQ-F-002 -> rule `02436480_9ff…` -> `COBTUPDT`] `requirements-derived`
- **REQ-F-003** — [Event-driven] When the next maintenance record is requested, the system shall read it from the transaction record data store; if no further records exist, the system shall set the end-of-input indicator to signal that processing is complete. [source: REQ-F-003 -> rule `9b9242d8_447…` -> `COBTUPDT`] `requirements-derived`
- **REQ-F-004** — [Event-driven] When a maintenance record is read, the system shall route it to the add handler if the operation indicator is `'A'`, to the update handler if it is `'U'`, to the delete handler if it is `'D'`, to the skip handler if it is `'*'`, and to the default handler for any other value. [source: REQ-F-004 -> rule `81318fbb_c1b…` -> `COBTUPDT`] `requirements-derived`
- **REQ-F-005** — [Event-driven] When an add record (`INPUT-REC-TYPE` = `'A'`) is dispatched for insertion, the system shall insert a new row into the transaction type catalogue store (`CARDDEMO.TRANSACTION_TYPE`) using the record's reference number (`INPUT-REC-NUMBER`) as the transaction type code (`TR_TYPE`) and the record's description (`INPUT-REC-DESC`) as the transaction description (`TR_DESCRIPTION`). [source: REQ-F-005 -> rule `ada19e41_88d…` -> `COBTUPDT`] `requirements-derived`
- **REQ-F-006** — [Event-driven] When a maintenance record with operation indicator `'U'` is dispatched, the system shall update the transaction type data store (`CARDDEMO.TRANSACTION_TYPE`) by replacing the stored description (`TR_DESCRIPTION`) of the row whose transaction type code (`TR_TYPE`) matches the record's reference number with the new description from the input record. [source: REQ-F-006 -> rule `4bfce005_e92…` -> `COBTUPDT`] `requirements-derived`
- **REQ-F-007** — [Event-driven] When a maintenance record with operation indicator `'D'` is dispatched, the system shall remove from the transaction type data store (`CARDDEMO.TRANSACTION_TYPE`) the row whose transaction type code (`TR_TYPE`) equals the record's reference number; no other rows shall be affected. [source: REQ-F-007 -> rule `545a1a8e_8c5…` -> `COBTUPDT`] `requirements-derived`
- **REQ-F-008** — [Ubiquitous] The system shall read all records from the transaction record data store (TR-RECORD) sequentially before applying any maintenance operations to the transaction type data store (CARDDEMO.TRANSACTION_TYPE). [source: REQ-F-008 -> rule `f180937b_69b…` -> `COBTUPDT`] `requirements-derived`
- **REQ-F-009** — [State-driven] While records remain to be processed, the system shall classify each record by its operation indicator, apply the corresponding maintenance action to the transaction type data store, and advance to the next record until the input is exhausted. [source: REQ-F-009 -> rule `02436480_9ff…` -> `COBTUPDT`] `requirements-derived`
- **REQ-F-010** — [Event-driven] When a record with action indicator `'A'` is dispatched for insertion, the system shall insert a new row into the transaction type catalogue store (`CARDDEMO.TRANSACTION_TYPE`) using the record's reference number (`INPUT-REC-NUMBER`) as the transaction type code (`TR_TYPE`) and the record's description (`INPUT-REC-DESC`) as the transaction description (`TR_DESCRIPTION`). [source: REQ-F-010 -> rule `65bc185c_536…` -> `COBTUPDT`] `requirements-derived`

- **REQ-F-001** — [Event-driven] When the user maintenance transaction is entered without a pre-selected user identifier, the system shall present an empty entry form with the cursor positioned on the user ID field. [source: REQ-F-001 -> rule `84c6ac65_4d5…` -> `COUSR02C`] `requirements-derived`
- **REQ-F-002** — [Event-driven] When the user maintenance transaction is entered with a pre-selected user identifier that is neither blank nor low-values, the system shall place that identifier into the user ID field and immediately execute the lookup path to retrieve and display the corresponding security record. - **REQ-F-007** — [Event-driven] When the administrator submits the user maintenance screen, the system shall capture the entered user ID, first name, last name, password, and user type for processing. [source: REQ-F-007 -> rule `1954e593_1b5…` -> `COUSR02C`] `requirements-derived`

[source: REQ-F-009 -> rule `e2c83d50_0df…` -> `COUSR02C`] `requirements-derived`
- **REQ-F-010** — [Event-driven] When the security record is found during lookup, the system shall display the message `'Press PF5 key to save your updates ...'`. [source: REQ-F-010 -> rule `05e05c4f_707…` -> `COUSR02C`] `requirements-derived`
